title: Solitaire
tagline: Klondike. Pick draw, undo, recycle — then deal.
blurb: Standard 52. Kings high. Foundations A–K by suit. Tableau down alternating color. Empty column: King. Choose draw 1 or 3, undo, and waste→stock recycle (always / once / never) before DEAL. Safe auto-play to foundations. Move whole face-up runs.

copy.playing: Tap a run, then a destination. KING on empty.
copy.options: Pick draw, undo, and recycle, then DEAL.
